summary: Listed as gone; a 1929 newspaper item quoted by a lookout history site describes an observer in the Suffolk fire tower that year.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source I read describes what remains at the site.

events.note: An observer in the Suffolk forest fire lookout tower reported 16 fires on March 29; the newspaper item is dated April 10, 1929

notes_for_editor: The eastern lookout site's Magnolia page says Orange County under the National Historic Lookout Register heading, while the FFLA list places Suffolk (Magnolia) in Suffolk at 36.73441, -76.55693. Check whether two Magnolia towers exist. The 1929 item is a newspaper quote, not a register entry. The Virginia Forestry Department is named on the Suffolk page's tower entry, but the extracted text does not label it as the agency, so no agency fact is recorded. No build date, length of service or fate found in the sources read. The Dismal Swamp tower in Suffolk is a different site, listed as standing.
